messages:
Kevin R: Quick heads-up — the 2.4.1 release looks like it might slip by ~2 business days. Cutoff PRs still incoming and a flaky test popped in canary.
Maya P: Ok — what's the ETA now? Need to update #announcements copy if we move the window.
Alex T: I'm on a CR that's blocking the bump (db migration ordering). I'll try to finish review this afternoon.
Kevin R: ETA tentatively Fri EOD PST. If we can't clear the gating PRs by then we ship Mon. Prefer to avoid Monday if possible.
Sara L: Changelog PR is open (link: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4123). I can trim non-user-facing entries — what should go in the headline?
Maya P: Headline: "Performance and stability release — improved batching and routing fallback". Can we get a 1-liner + 2 bullets? I'll post to #announcements once copy is final.
Alex T: For oncall: @oncall can we hold off any infra changes during the ship window? Also CI shows 1 flaky test `test_kv_cache_eviction` failing in canary.
ci-bot: build 5892 failed on `test_kv_cache_eviction` — rerun scheduled.
deploy-bot: canary deploy 2026-03-16T15:22Z: partially degraded, rolling back to canary-2026-03-15. See logs: https://deploys.redwood/status/5892
Kevin R: Thanks for the flags. Contingency: if canary instability persists, we fallback to previous model quant profile and proceed with the rest of the changes — low-risk path. Will coordinate with infra.
Maya P: Please draft the announcement copy here. Keep it short: 1 sentence + 2 bullets (what's new, user impact). I'll tweak and post.
Alex T: Draft below:

"Release v2.4.1 window moved to Fri (tentative) due to canary stability checks."
- Improved batching and routing fallback for lower tail latency.
- Fixed rare KV-cache eviction race observed under high-concurrency.

Kevin R: LGTM, just change "moved to Fri" -> "targeting Fri EOD PST; may slip to Mon if gating tests fail." 
Sara L: Updated changelog headline and added the two bullets. Trimmed dev-only notes.
Maya P: I'll post to #announcements once Alex updates the line to Kevin's wording. Also, can someone @eng-releases when we lock the branch?
Alex T: Will do the branch lock after I merge the CR. Pushing final fixes now.
Kevin R: Cool. If anything blocks, drop a quick note here — otherwise I'll post the slip notice and ETA in #announcements after lock. :thumbsup: 
Sara L: FYI — changelog PR updated at https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4123/files (commit abc123).
Alex T: Merge done. Branch `release/2.4` locked. @Maya P you can publish the announcement. :rocket: 
Maya P: Posted to #announcements: "Targeting Fri EOD PST for v2.4.1; continuing validation. We'll notify if we need to delay to Mon." :email: 
Kevin R: Thanks everyone. Monitoring canary now, will post final go/no-go by 4pm PST.
Maya P: tagging this thread as our single-source for the announcement flow. :white_check_mark:
